name: Reasoning Swarm
description: Use when a decision or proposal has genuine multi-stakeholder stakes, spans multiple teams, or carries organization-scale or hard-to-reverse consequences — build-vs-buy calls, architecture decisions affecting several teams, policy with systemic impact, or when the user explicitly wants independent parallel takes stress-tested against each other rather than one recursive pass. Skip for single-claim analysis or solo stress-testing (use reasoning-framework instead), time-pressured decisions, mechanical tasks, or when a recommendation is wanted rather than a tour of considerations.

conversationStarters: Get independent takes on this decision: …
Should we build or buy for …?
Stress-test this proposal from several independent angles: …
What am I missing on this org-wide decision?
